note_measurement.caveat: A deterministic300-character sizing probe, not actual scientific notes or an upper bound for arbitrary Unicode notes. Runtime exact-token guard remains mandatory.
note_measurement.construction: Unicode codepoints U+4E00 through U+4F2B inclusive, once each in ascending order

retention_rule.component_breakdown: Exact fixed-order signed increments plus explicitly non-additive standalone component counts
retention_rule.failure_flag_definition: True iff any observed TRAIN/validation failure category count is positive
retention_rule.failure_reasons: phase -> category -> count; no row IDs, tracebacks or source summaries added
retention_rule.initial_view_round_records: Only latest3 complete query/note/feature-reference records from the start; all historical feature metadata until6000 trim
retention_rule.policy: Initially include all historical feature-instance metadata and ONLY the latest3 complete round records. A feature instance is identified by its original one-based round and zero-based feature index. Store only source SHA256, LOFO delta_without_minus_full, any-failure flag and aggregate failure reasons. Never put feature names, descriptions, code, code summaries, sample identities or held-out feedback in memory. Round records reference feature instances and contain ordered canonical queries, match/reveal/carry statistics and one complete note of at most300 Unicode characters. Count the entire canonical compact sorted JSON with the unchanged pinned6000-token counter. If over6000, retain the top30 UNIQUE SOURCE HASHES by their LATEST LOFO delta descending (None last; ties first_seen_round,first_seen_feature_index,sourceSHA256). Retain every historical feature-instance metadata item referencing those30 hashes, union every feature instance referenced by the latest3 complete round records. This is the original unique-hash ranking. Keep ONLY those latest3 round records after trimming; older notes/query records are not retained. Do not truncate notes, iterate trimming or change this format to fit a measured result. If this one prescribed retained view is still over6000, stop before a model request. The complete scientific source ledger remains separately preserved outside memory.
retention_rule.remaining_overflow_action: Stop before any model call, no iterative truncation
retention_rule.tie_rule: LATEST LOFO delta for each unique source hash descending; None last; first_seen_round,first_seen_feature_index,sourceSHA256
retention_rule.trim_action: Original unique-hash ranking; one pass all historical instances of top30hashes union latest3 feature refs; onlylatest3 detailed records/notes/queries remain
